Maya Barnes: Quick sync — Meridian QBR orchestration thread. Need exec slide + 5-min demo readiness. Can we confirm slide owners, outstanding asks, and owners for post-QBR follow-ups? Demo Tue 11/28.
Jalen Ortiz: Ack. Can we lock the exec slide by EOD Friday? Exec wants 1–2 bullets on adoption and renewal health.
Maya Barnes: I'll own the exec slide (customer health + renewal ask). Priya: can you do the technical appendix and rollout timeline?
Priya Singh: Yep. I'll add a one-slide architecture + migration blockers. Need the latest infra perf numbers from Tom.
Tom Wu: Uploading infra perf CSV to the deck now — added v0.3 at https://drive.redwood/meridian/qbr/v0.3
Tom Wu: Quick callout: p95 latency improved after hotfix but token cost spiked ~12% month-over-month. Adding a note page.
Nora Patel: CS scorecard snapshot: adoption=68%, active seats +3% q/q, renewal sentiment = neutral. Renewal currently flagged YELLOW.
Maya Barnes: Can you bullet the reasons for the yellow flag so we can present them succinctly?
Nora Patel: Reasons: 1) onboarding incomplete for two enterprise teams; 2) usage spike causing cost sensitivity; 3) execs asking for stricter SLOs. Also one security checklist item outstanding with partner SI.
Jalen Ortiz: Action items (owners/due):
- Exec slide (Maya) — Fri 17:00
- Tech appendix + perf notes (Priya/Tom) — Thu 12:00
- Renewal mitigation plan + exec ask draft (Nora) — Mon 09:00
- Demo script + slim slide set (Maya/Priya) — Mon 12:00
Maya Barnes: Runbook snippet I'll paste here for the demo fallback:
```
Runbook extract:
- Slide owners produce a 1-paragraph speaker note.
- Demo to use sandbox tenant: meridian-stage
- If live backend exhibits latency >500ms for >30s, switch to recorded run (link in deck)
- Post-QBR: send follow-up with owners/actions within 24h
```
Priya Singh: One product ask — what single metric should we surface to execs? '90-day retention uplift' or 'time-to-first-successful-query'? @Jalen
Jalen Ortiz: Use '90-day retention uplift' as headline. Secondary metric: 'time-to-first-successful-query'. Keep visuals simple.
